note.note:
I’m ready to generate the Problem List Clinical Note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The full transcript (doctor–patient conversation).
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON.

Once I have both, I will produce the note with:
- Consult Summary (two-line), followed by
- Problem List (Issue 1, Issue 2, Issue 3 as applicable) with timeline, symptoms, systems review, social history, medications, exam findings, consistent DDx with likelihood tags, and brief justification
- Medications
- Allergies
- Past Medical History
- Social History
- Preventative History
- Physical Examination
- Plan
- Quality Checks section detailing any missing elements, conflicts between transcript and DDx (marked if present), and any notes on transcript quality

Notes:
- I will treat the transcript as the primary source and use the DDx only to clarify or support differential considerations if consistent with the transcript.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If transcript and DDx conflict, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”
- I will avoid adding details not present in the transcript or DDx.
